topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I appreciate you reaching out with this idea, honestly. The thought of seeing the yard used in a way that benefits someone, that’s a nice notion. But there are just so many things to consider, you know? The upkeep, the time it would take, and well, it’s just a lot on my plate right now. I worry about the boundaries, the changes it might bring to the space I’ve grown accustomed to. It’s a significant step, and I need to think about it carefully. I hope you understand. Maybe we can talk more about it another time, when I’ve had some more time to think things through?
